subtopics.label: Residency & Fellowship Curriculum Development
subtopics.description: Research on the design, implementation, and evaluation of training curricula within residency and fellowship programs across medical specialties, including competency-based education, scholarly activity, and program director perspectives.
subtopics.short_description: Design, implementation, and evaluation of competency-based curricula across residency and fellowship programs.

subtopics.label: Simulation-Based & Procedural Skills Training
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating simulation models, high-fidelity simulators, 3D-printed models, virtual reality, and augmented reality tools for procedural and clinical skills training across surgical and non-surgical specialties.
subtopics.short_description: High-fidelity simulators, 3D-printed models, and virtual reality tools for clinical and procedural skills training.

subtopics.label: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion in Medicine
subtopics.description: Research examining gender, racial, and ethnic representation in academic medicine, surgical specialties, and training programs, including initiatives to address disparities in faculty promotion, awards, and recruitment of underrepresented minorities.
subtopics.short_description: Gender, racial, and ethnic representation in academic medicine, faculty promotion, and recruitment of underrepresented minorities.

subtopics.label: Faculty Development & Academic Leadership
subtopics.description: Research on faculty development programs, leadership curricula, mentorship, academic promotion, and the skills and roles needed for effective leadership in academic medicine and medical education.
subtopics.short_description: Leadership curricula, mentorship, academic promotion, and faculty development programs in academic medicine.

subtopics.label: Physician & Healthcare Worker Burnout and Well-Being
subtopics.description: Studies investigating burnout prevalence, moral distress, compassion fatigue, and wellness interventions among physicians, residents, fellows, and other healthcare professionals across specialties.
subtopics.short_description: Burnout prevalence, moral distress, and wellness interventions among physicians, residents, and healthcare professionals.

subtopics.label: Medical Student Education & Clerkship Training
subtopics.description: Research on undergraduate medical education including clerkship curricula, assessment methods, virtual and remote learning innovations, and student engagement across clinical and preclinical training.
subtopics.short_description: Clerkship curricula, assessment methods, and virtual learning innovations across preclinical and clinical training.

subtopics.label: Telehealth, Virtual Learning & Digital Education Technologies
subtopics.description: Research on the use of telemedicine, virtual classrooms, e-learning platforms, augmented reality, and digital tools for medical education, remote clinical training, and healthcare delivery.
subtopics.short_description: E-learning platforms, virtual classrooms, and digital tools for remote clinical training and healthcare delivery.

subtopics.label: Surgical Training, Learning Curves & Operative Education
subtopics.description: Studies examining surgical skill acquisition, learning curves, operative autonomy assessment, research training during surgical residency, and the impact of experience on surgical outcomes.
subtopics.short_description: Learning curves, operative autonomy, and the impact of surgical experience on trainee outcomes.

subtopics.label: Home Health Aides & Direct Care Workforce
subtopics.description: Research on the training, health, working conditions, job satisfaction, and role of home health aides and direct care workers in supporting patients with chronic conditions such as heart failure.
subtopics.short_description: Training, working conditions, and job satisfaction of home health aides supporting patients with chronic conditions.

subtopics.label: Palliative Care Education & Clinician Training
subtopics.description: Research on training programs, competency development, and educational interventions for palliative care and hospice medicine clinicians, including mental health integration, communication skills, and fellowship program curricula.
subtopics.short_description: Competency development and educational interventions for palliative care and hospice medicine clinicians.

subtopics.label: Global Health Education & Capacity Building in Low-Resource Settings
subtopics.description: Studies on surgical training, capacity building, and healthcare education initiatives in low- and middle-income countries, including telementoring, simulation-based training, and surgical camps in sub-Saharan Africa and other resource-limited settings.
subtopics.short_description: Surgical training, telementoring, and healthcare education initiatives in low- and middle-income countries.

subtopics.label: COVID-19 Impact on Healthcare Workforce & Training
subtopics.description: Research examining how the COVID-19 pandemic affected healthcare worker well-being, clinical training disruptions, redeployment, and institutional adaptations in residency programs and clinical operations.
subtopics.short_description: Pandemic effects on healthcare worker well-being, clinical training disruptions, and residency program adaptations.

subtopics.label: Communication Skills Training & Patient-Provider Interaction
subtopics.description: Research on educational interventions, curricula, and assessment tools designed to improve clinician communication skills, including breaking bad news, prognostic communication, and patient-provider concordance effects on care.
subtopics.short_description: Curricula and assessment tools to improve clinician communication, including prognostic and bad-news delivery skills.

subtopics.label: ICU Staffing, Workforce Models & Clinical Outcomes
subtopics.description: Studies examining intensivist staffing ratios, ICU workforce composition, advanced practice provider roles, and the relationship between staffing patterns and patient outcomes in critical care settings.
subtopics.short_description: Intensivist staffing ratios, advanced practice provider roles, and their relationship to critical care patient outcomes.

subtopics.label: Radiology & Imaging Education and Training
subtopics.description: Research on curriculum development, simulation tools, fellowship training, and competency assessment in diagnostic radiology and breast imaging education. Includes longitudinal curricula, hands-on MRI training, oral boards preparation, and integration of radiology into clinical clerkships.
subtopics.short_description: Curriculum development, simulation tools, and competency assessment in diagnostic radiology and breast imaging training.

subtopics.label: Pediatric Behavioral & Mental Health Competency Training
subtopics.description: Studies examining how pediatric residents and fellows acquire competency in behavioral and mental health care, including training site characteristics, educational resources, and self-reported preparedness for managing pediatric mental health conditions.
subtopics.short_description: How pediatric trainees acquire competency in behavioral and mental health care, including preparedness and training resources.

subtopics.label: Opioid Use Disorder Treatment: Clinician Attitudes, Stigma & Practice Patterns
subtopics.description: Research on how clinician stigma, training background, and institutional policies shape treatment of opioid use disorder and substance use disorders, including prescribing behavior, harm reduction approaches, and barriers to medication-assisted treatment.
subtopics.display_name: Clinician Attitudes & Opioid Use Disorder Treatment
subtopics.short_description: Stigma, training, and institutional policies shaping clinician prescribing and harm reduction for opioid use disorder.

subtopics.label: CPR, Bleeding Control & Community Emergency Response Training
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating bystander and community-level training programs in cardiopulmonary resuscitation, hemorrhage control (Stop the Bleed), and emergency response skills, including program implementation, effectiveness, and barriers to adoption.
subtopics.short_description: Bystander training programs in CPR, hemorrhage control, and emergency response skills, including adoption barriers.

subtopics.label: Elder Mistreatment Detection, Assessment & Clinical Response
subtopics.description: Research on identifying, documenting, and responding to elder mistreatment across clinical settings including emergency departments and prehospital care, encompassing tool development, interdisciplinary team models, and specialist roles.
subtopics.short_description: Identifying and responding to elder mistreatment across clinical settings, including tool development and interdisciplinary models.

subtopics.label: Interprofessional Collaboration, Peer Coaching & Team-Based Care Training
subtopics.description: Studies on training peer coaches, lay health workers, and interprofessional teams to deliver or support clinical care, including motivational interviewing, collaborative care models, and facilitators and barriers to interprofessional practice.
subtopics.short_description: Training peer coaches and interprofessional teams in collaborative care models and motivational interviewing.

subtopics.label: Nursing Home & Long-Term Care Workforce Burnout and Turnover
subtopics.description: Research examining how resident aggression, burnout, and fatigue contribute to staff turnover intentions in nursing homes and long-term care facilities, including cross-cultural studies and leadership factors affecting resilience.
subtopics.short_description: Resident aggression, burnout, and leadership factors driving staff turnover in nursing homes and long-term care facilities.

subtopics.label: Diagnostic Error, Clinical Practice Gaps & Quality Improvement
subtopics.description: Studies identifying gaps in clinical diagnosis, screening, and practice patterns across specialties, including diagnostic errors in stroke and neurology, screening adherence, and quality improvement initiatives to address care deficiencies.
subtopics.short_description: Gaps in clinical diagnosis, screening adherence, and quality improvement initiatives to address care deficiencies across specialties.

subtopics.label: Medical & University Student Mental Health and Well-Being
subtopics.description: Research on mental health, stress, and well-being among medical and university students, including factors associated with perceived stress, internet addiction, and interventions to support student mental health across diverse populations.
subtopics.short_description: Stress, mental health, and well-being among medical and university students, including interventions across diverse populations.

subtopics.label: Specialty-Specific Competency Assessment & Training Programs
subtopics.description: Studies evaluating competency assessment tools, training curricula, and educational interventions across medical specialties including pharmacy, genetic counseling, speech-language pathology, and emergency medicine, with focus on skill acquisition and knowledge gaps.
subtopics.short_description: Competency tools and training curricula across pharmacy, genetic counseling, speech-language pathology, and emergency medicine.

subtopics.label: Healthcare System Policy, Workforce Organization & Practice Patterns
subtopics.description: Research examining how healthcare system structures, policies, and physician practice patterns affect care delivery, including hospital-physician integration, telehealth delivery variation, single-payer perspectives, and academic compensation models.
subtopics.short_description: How system structures, policies, and physician practice patterns shape care delivery, integration models, and compensation.

subtopics.label: Arts, Humanities & Reflective Practice in Medicine
subtopics.description: Studies on the use of creative arts, poetry, music therapy, contemplative medicine, and humanities-based approaches to support clinician well-being, patient care, and professional identity formation in medical settings.
subtopics.short_description: Creative arts, poetry, and humanities-based approaches supporting clinician well-being and professional identity formation.

subtopics.label: Patient-Provider Trust, Engagement & Shared Decision-Making
subtopics.description: Research on factors shaping patient trust in providers, patient perspectives on care quality, race concordance effects, and clinician strategies for building therapeutic relationships and addressing patient concerns.
subtopics.short_description: Factors shaping patient trust, race concordance effects, and clinician strategies for building therapeutic relationships.

subtopics.label: Health Equity, Disparities & Community-Based Screening
subtopics.description: Studies addressing racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic health disparities through community screening programs, equity-focused clinical trial design, implicit bias in clinical care, and social determinants of health integration into practice.
subtopics.short_description: Racial, ethnic, and socioeconomic health disparities addressed through community screening and social determinants of health integration.
